as_told.title: MIT president rumored shown craft at Wright Airfield

plain: In 1950, Karl Compton, then president of MIT, was briefed on UFO technology at Wright Field, an Air Force airfield in Ohio, according to a man named Robert Sarbacher, who is said to have told this to a nuclear engineer and UFO researcher named Stanton Friedman. Michels repeats Sarbacher's account as Friedman reported it; in another episode he puts it more strongly, saying the MIT president was rumoured to have been shown the craft itself, without naming Compton, Sarbacher or a date. If true, it would mean one of America's leading scientists was let in on recovered UFO hardware.
